purpose: Nine-requirement work index, not execution authorization or live acceptance. A source merge or historical checkpoint does not establish current deployment, data quality or research readiness.

source_checkpoint.verification: Fresh clone matched origin/main, clean, zero unpushed; generated binding/acquisition/governed-routing/pilot-contract checks passed.
source_checkpoint.scope: Historical source-only checkpoint, not an automatically updated latest SHA. Test/docs changes do not require an unchanged Worker to be redeployed.

acceptance.source: Use the exact reviewed commit and its native check, not a phase label or this checkpoint's age.
acceptance.staging_and_production: Use the current approved target-specific record: source, actual module and Container image where applicable, bindings and smokes. Do not copy a mutable version inventory here or claim all Workers coherent from a subset.
acceptance.data: No accepted full candidate scope is established here. Acquisition or Cron PASS is not snapshot reproof.
acceptance.ready: NOT_PROVEN_BY_THIS_LEDGER. Requires same-snapshot scope, physical bytes, quality, profile and closure evidence.
acceptance.pilot: NOT_PROVEN_BY_THIS_LEDGER. Requires applicable execution approval and all live gates; DRAFT cannot substitute.
acceptance.mass_and_orders: Disabled; no Mass, FoF, broker, live orders or automatic promotion.

execution_rules.quota_stop: Below roughly 20 percent weekly remaining, finish a safe saved/pushed checkpoint, report remaining work and human steps, then stop. Do not use a reset credit without explicit approval.
execution_rules.work_in_progress: At most three simultaneous work items; main implements and subagents only perform independent read-only review under AGENTS.md.
execution_rules.approval: Use current explicit grouped approval. Authentication and historical assent are not new job or spending authority. Exhausted allocations and terminal jobs must not restart implicitly.
execution_rules.scope: Source, rollout, data activation, authority activation and research execution are separate outcomes. Rollout approval does not authorize research.
execution_rules.cost: No assurance-only market scans, repeated counts or unchanged-state polling. A monitored cost target is not an invoice hard cap.
execution_rules.storage: No authentic market history persisted locally or local Docker/VM backtests. R2 market bodies, bounded D1 metadata, cloud scratch. Preserve signed bytes.
execution_rules.recovery: No production DLQ body reads/ack/purge. No old whole-DB restore after writers resume. Preserve signed evidence and use forward repair.
